true_leverage.ability: Committing fast and fully to a real, graspable resource — converting a spotted opportunity into a held position while others are still evaluating it.
true_leverage.statement: Your true lever is the direct line from judgment to commitment: once you see that a resource is real and can be taken, you secure it, and you keep it through disciplined management.
true_leverage.why_not_others: The accumulating habit and the system-knowledge are maintenance, not engines. Retention preserves what has already arrived; it generates nothing new. The structural knowledge gives you footing and legitimacy; it also generates nothing new. Both run on the same stock of held assets. Only the opportunity-facing force actively pulls fresh resources toward you: Indirect Wealth stands at both the year and hour stems, flanking the whole chart, and Direct Wealth is the heaviest single presence overall. Because expression energy weighs nothing here, no attention drains sideways into open-ended exploration; because peer support is absent from the day master's side, no energy splits into consensus or negotiation. One unit of scanning converts almost entirely into a taken position. That conversion rate is the rare asset — the other two abilities are common and replaceable; this one is not.
true_leverage.evidence: Two Indirect Wealth stems flank the chart at the year and hour positions, and Direct Wealth is the heaviest Ten God overall — the month pillar Yi Mao reinforces the resource-facing current. The day master stands strong but without Companion support, and the output family (Hurting Officer, Eating God) carries no weight, so nothing feeds exploration or delegation. Direct Resource hidden in the month branch You supplies just enough structural backing to keep what is taken.

use_cases.scene: A time-sensitive acquisition appears — an asset, a piece of equipment, a contract slot, a small business, or a position that can actually be taken.
use_cases.action: Run your scan and commit within your own deadline, then immediately formalize: signed paper, transferred funds, or booked slot — the same day. Do not wait for consensus; your chart has no Companion force, and seeking agreement only burns the window. After committing, switch deliberately from scan mode to hold mode: put the acquisition into your ledger system the same week, with entry, cost, and review date. The commit instinct is the lever; the ledger is what makes the commit compound instead of scatter. One catch you must add manually: before signing, write three lines on why this resource is real. If the three lines are thin next to the speed of your commitment, slow by half a day — nothing will be lost.
use_cases.evidence: Indirect Wealth at the year and hour stems drives the scanning-and-committing current; Direct Wealth heaviest overall means the strongest calibration instrument is a concrete position with money in and costs out, visible within weeks.

use_cases.scene: A negotiation where the other side moves slowly — vendor terms, a partnership, a purchase at a price that keeps drifting.
use_cases.action: Structure the deal so your commitment is the concession you trade. Offer certainty: fast close, clean payment, no committees on your side — in exchange for price or terms. This works because your structure genuinely has no negotiation overhead; you can close when they cannot. Then protect the close with a system behind it: a written contract, an escrow, an institution that co-signs. Your day master runs solo — no Companion pillar — so every obligation you hold informally rests entirely on your own grip. Each contract you attach moves load from your grip onto structure, which frees attention for the next scan. Concretely: for every deal above a set threshold you choose, no close without a written instrument naming a counterparty.
use_cases.evidence: No Companion support to the day master means negotiation and consensus cost you disproportionate attention; Direct Resource hidden in the month branch You is the only structural prop, so written backing multiplies a scarce input.

use_cases.scene: Someone asks you to build or create something original — a product from scratch, content, a design, a strategy from a blank page.
use_cases.action: Decline the blank-page framing and reframe the task as acquisition-and-arrangement: find two or three existing approaches worth taking, commit to one, and improve it under your management. Do not attempt pure creation on demand — the expression family weighs nothing in your chart, so a blank page gives you nothing to grip, and you will drift into controlling process instead while calling it diligence. Watch for that drift specifically: if you find yourself polishing timelines, formats, and approval steps on a creative task, you have substituted grip for making. The honest move is to say: I take, hold, and improve positions; I do not conjure from nothing — and route the task accordingly. This is not a limitation to hide; it is a job description to state.
use_cases.evidence: Hurting Officer and Eating God carry zero weight, so output energy — the force behind original expression — is absent; Direct Wealth dominance means improvement of existing, valued things is where your attention converts to results.

next_90_days.one_thing: Install one recurring output valve: a fixed weekly block, on the calendar like a client commitment, that produces something usable and visible — a cooked meal for others, a repaired object, a written piece published anywhere, a finished build — but is not monetized and not optimized. The purpose is not the product; it is training the missing half of your loop. Your chart runs acquisition and retention at full strength with zero expression weight, so energy accumulates with no release channel except more acquisition. The wood-branch decades beginning around age fifty-three and sixty-three will open that channel whether you prepare or not; a habit installed now means it opens into a functioning valve instead of a burst pipe.
next_90_days.completion_signal: Verifiable at day ninety: twelve consecutive weekly blocks completed, each with a tangible artifact you can point to — a photo, a published link, a dish someone ate. Miss two weeks total and the signal fails; restart the count. The pass condition is the streak, not the quality of the artifacts.
next_90_days.evidence: Output Ten Gods weigh nothing while Direct Wealth is heaviest — a pure intake-and-hold circuit; the upcoming wood-branch luck pillars from roughly age fifty-three feed the expression family, so the valve must exist as habit before timing supplies the pressure.

falsification_signals.signal: Over a full quarter with real opportunities present, your commitments repeatedly underperform held alternatives — you take positions faster than others and the ledger shows the taken positions returned less than simply waiting or doing nothing would have. If the fast-commit instinct produces measurably worse results across at least three separate acquisitions with weeks-visible feedback, then the lever described here is not operating in your actual environment, and this manual's core claim is wrong for you as run, not just in theory.
falsification_signals.evidence: The leverage claim rests on Indirect Wealth flanking at year and hour stems plus heaviest Direct Wealth; if that conversion repeatedly fails where it should be strongest — concrete assets with fast feedback — the structural reading does not match observed behavior.

falsification_signals.signal: You find yourself sustainably energized, not drained, by open-ended creation — blank-page work that you return to voluntarily for a month or more, producing output you consider good, without it collapsing into process-control or grip behavior. This manual predicts the expression family carries no weight and that you will substitute control for making on creative tasks. If direct observation contradicts that — sustained, voluntary, self-judged-good original output — then the weight distribution as applied to your behavior is not describing how you actually run, and the instruction to avoid blank-page roles should be discarded.
falsification_signals.evidence: Zero weight on Hurting Officer and Eating God underlies the no-expression prediction; sustained contrary behavior over a real month is evidence the prediction fails in practice, regardless of the theoretical distribution.
